caution: Overlapping editorial routes, not precise invention dates or causal links. A case can appear in several routes; read its period and episode interval. Archaeology, reconstructions, publication dates and operating episodes are not interchangeable.

routes.title: Early fired materials
routes.scope: Late Pleistocene/early Holocene archaeological occurrences and later use evidence; dates are not universal origin claims.

routes.title: Early cultivation, water and metal systems
routes.scope: Dated archaeological and textual episodes before or spanning the first millennium BCE. Modern rehabilitation/replica observations in these cases are separate.

routes.title: Classical and early imperial operation
routes.scope: Roman-period systems and ancient Chinese maintenance evidence; uncertain authorial dates and separate later emergencies remain explicit.

routes.title: First and second millennia: materials, exchange and cultivation
routes.scope: Broadly pre-1500 routes, often with earlier roots or later subepisodes. The row does not assign regions to one developmental stage.

routes.title: Fifteenth to eighteenth centuries: craft, institutions and transmission
routes.scope: Overlapping histories of publishing, navigation, mine power, firearms, variolation and precision work. Observation dates are retained per case.

routes.title: Eighteenth and nineteenth centuries: production and public systems
routes.scope: Task-specific industrial changes, competing production routes, metrication, precision and colonial infrastructure. No general industrial-stage chronology is implied.

routes.title: Late nineteenth to mid-twentieth centuries: networks and contested work
routes.scope: Urban infrastructure, electrification, textiles, transport and labour. Later persistence and retrospective interviews are separated from the original operating intervals.

routes.title: Mid to late twentieth century: manufacturing, public programmes and renewal
routes.scope: Many cases continue into the twenty-first century. Manufacture, adoption, historical reconstruction and later study dates are different observations.

routes.title: Twenty-first-century use, trials and knowledge recovery
routes.scope: Dated studies and contemporary subepisodes, not a claim that the techniques originated then. Archaeological/experimental comparators stay distinct; final-abstract and manuscript boundaries remain.
